Short title extent and commencement

CUTTING OF TREES (PROHIBITION) ACT, 1975
CUTTING OF TREES (PROHIBITION) ACT, 1975
1. Short title, extent and commencement.‑(1)
This Act maybe called the Cutting of Trees (Prohibition) Act, 1975.
(2) It extends to the whole of Pakistan.
(3) It shall come into force at once.

Definitions

CUTTING OF TREES (PROHIBITION) ACT, 1975
CUTTING OF TREES (PROHIBITION) ACT, 1975
2. Definitions.‑In this Act, unless there is
anything repugnant in the subject or context,‑
(a) "formation" means a Corps, Division or
Brigade of the Pakistan Army ;
(b) "local formation commander", in
relation to an area, means an .officer for the time being in command of the
formation in the area ; and
(c) "tree" means a large plant with a self‑supporting
trunk.

Cutting etc of trees prohibited

CUTTING OF TREES (PROHIBITION) ACT, 1975
CUTTING OF TREES (PROHIBITION) ACT, 1975
3. Cutting etc., of trees prohibited.‑Notwithstanding
anything con tained in any other law for the time being in force, no person
shall, without the prior written approval of the local formation commander or
an officer authorised by him in this behalf, cut, fell or damage or cause to be
cut, felled or damaged any free growing within the five miles belt along the
external frontiers of Pakistan.

Penalty

CUTTING OF TREES (PROHIBITION) ACT, 1975
CUTTING OF TREES (PROHIBITION) ACT, 1975
4. Penalty.‑Whoever contravenes the provisions
of this Act or the rules made thereunder shall be punishable with imprisonment
for a term which may extend to three years, or with fine, or with both.
